intended_object: The topology on a ring R defined by a ring filter basis B: the unique ring topology in which the sets of B form a basis of neighborhoods of 0. Inferred from the docstring and the surrounding module.
explanation: The definition reuses the topology of the underlying additive group filter basis. That topology has the translates a + U, for U in B, as neighborhoods of a, and B as a basis of neighborhoods of 0. This is the standard construction. The extra axioms of a ring filter basis are what make multiplication continuous. The module proves this separately (`isTopologicalRing`), so the topology itself does not need to change. The definition works for any (possibly noncommutative) ring, which is the natural generality.
